workItems.title: Establish portable Metrics primitives and host-owned recording contracts
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Implement the approved portable CIS-owned metric definitions, finite units/string dimensions, counter/up-down/gauge/histogram/timer/observable semantics as thin BCL adapters. Stable registrations reuse handles, incompatible translated definitions fail, invalid recordings drop with bounded diagnostics, timer first Stop/Dispose fixes exactly one attempt. Establish host-owned Meter/attachment and actual callback admission/drain seams preserving existing constructors/pre-DI services, disabled behavior and Core closure; no aggregate engine/global latest-provider. Own portable contracts/fixtures, meaningful tests/docs/review and freeze APIs/catalog before dependent work.
workItems.validation: Native independent values and BCL listener cases for MET01/02 and A01-04: numeric semantics, timer race and invalid completion no retry, schema/name/translated child collisions and bounded capacity/invalid-input behavior. Verify public consumer API excludes BCL/SDK instrumentation types, Core dependency closure unchanged and proposed optional binding can use host-owned references. Inspect actual six-module attachment/lifetime seams before freezing; no speculative service or collector.

workItems.title: Instrument actual Logging Heartbeat and Healthcheck runtime boundaries
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Use the frozen host-owned facade/seam to observe actual Logging admission/consumption/discard/writer facts, real Heartbeat execution duration/active/outcome and actual Healthcheck evaluation/readiness/state. Keep finite configured aliases or aggregate safe categories, no GUID/type/logger labels or invented general spool bytes/skipped waiting. Preserve constructors, results, cancellation, overwrite/readiness/scheduling behavior, and isolate metrics failures from module failure paths. Do not edit shared hosting/project/provider files; include coherent catalog/tests/docs/review.
workItems.validation: One real normal/failure path per changed runtime module emits automatically when enabled and behavior stays unchanged when disabled; held work/owner behavior and real snapshot states are preserved. Existing native Unit/Integration/Business and affected compatibility/architecture checks use actual service entry points, not test-only intercepted counters. Logging stage boundaries remain distinct; HC scraping does not cause evaluation and HB capacity wait is not a skip.

workItems.title: Implement bounded OpenTelemetry collection policy and early lifecycle proof
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Add only the optional pinned compatible SDK/exporter package and lock closure. One provider/reader, exact host Meter selection and total nonthrowing Drop for foreign/unselected instruments; one effective view combines reserved-key exclusion, allowed keys, capacity/buckets. Capture authoritative EnvironmentOptions identity and finite catalog/late native capacities, disable exemplars, preserve overflow and bounded diagnostics. Establish early actual all-sample identity and callback-admission/drain proof before broad integration; do not treat provider Dispose/HTTP timeout as settlement. Own policy tests/docs/review, no exporter/aggregation replacement.
workItems.validation: Actual compatible locked restore/build and native A04/A06-A08 controls; parse real exporter data for authoritative native/CIS/histogram/overflow/target_info identity, resource/tag override attempts, late caps and static startup options. Verify two host-owned Meter selections and held callback after timeout/stop using existing native fixtures. Retain exact package identities, failed observations and actual costs; optional closure cannot enter Core.

workItems.title: Integrate Metrics hosting native HTTP and measured consumer delivery
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Expose the real reserved /_metrics exporter branch before readiness, with standard two-permit/no-queue limiting, timeout/cache/size limits and actual callback-owner settlement. Native ASP.NET duration/active instrumentation supplies HTTP counts/timing; thin idempotent policy handles routes/status/auth/reexecution and exact management exclusions without duplicate recording. Integrate all completed automatic module observations and real pre-DI/same-host lifetimes. Deliver optional-package/example consumption, portable exported expectations/queries, concise skill and AGENTS routing, one focused defaultcatalog footprint/response/plateau result and truthful scope/cost/platform limits. No new harness, serializer, aggregator or release campaign.
workItems.validation: A05-A14 real Kestrel parser/negotiation/escaping/cumulative scrapes; identity and override protection on all supported sample kinds; smallcap overflow, oversized/slow/concurrent scrape behavior; native success/error/authorization/cancellation/reexecution/route/probe cases. Two real hosts isolate both CIS and native values. Hold an observable callback across timedout request/hoststop and prove actual owner protection. Configuration does not rebuild provider and pre-DI facts are not replayed. One defaultcatalog memory/response observation records warmup, exact catalog/labels/buckets/concurrency, retainedmanageddelta64MiBtarget and capinteraction; actual package/example and proportional six-category regressions, skills validate/audit noLLM, documentation and independent scope review. Completion requires the runtime/bootstrap instrumentation tasks integrated and all bounded required evidence settled.
